statement: SELECT * FROM sell(:store_id::text, CASE WHEN :product_id::text = 'P0042' THEN '__never__' WHEN random() < (SELECT value FROM demo_setting WHERE key = 'sales_per_min_per_store') / 240 * COALESCE((SELECT weight FROM product_weight WHERE product_id = :product_id::text), 0) THEN :product_id::text ELSE '__never__' END, :qty::integer)
